description: Check a checkout created by create_checkout and, once it is paid, return the delivery link for a digital product. Call it after handing the person the checkout URL – leave a few seconds between calls, it is not a busy-wait. Requires the session_id create_checkout returned: orders cannot be listed, searched, or looked up by email, and no personal data (email, name, address) is ever returned.
name: get_order
title: Check order status
